Transport Modes

बल्क बैग

A flexible intermediate bulk container (FIBC), usually made of woven polypropylene, designed for storing and transporting dry, flowable products such as sand, fertilizer, or grain.

Quick answer: A flexible intermediate bulk container (FIBC), usually made of woven polypropylene, designed for storing and transporting dry, flowable products such as sand, fertilizer, or grain.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A flexible intermediate bulk container (FIBC), usually made of woven polypropylene, designed for storing and transporting dry, flowable products such as sand, fertilizer, or grain.

Operational example

Bulk bags are widely used in shipping for transporting powdered, granular, or bulk solid materials efficiently and safely.
